name: @equin/plugin-primitives-perfs-task-marks
description: Say what the main thread is starting, for whoever watches it from another thread: runMarked(source, describe, fn) wraps a task's entry point (begin before, end one microtask after); onTaskMark installs the one listener (main-thread-stall posts both to its out-of-thread watchdog, so a tab that freezes inside the task has already said which: the mark left open).
